data.name: Speed Boat Rental
data.headline: $237.44 – $634.94 • 21+ to drive (w/valid driver's license)
data.description:
Embark on a bay adventure with San Diego Boat Rentals, conveniently located at the Coronado Ferry Landing. Get ready to make waves as you experience the thrill of boating on San Diego Bay!

Max of 8 people per speed boat.
data.what_is_included:
The experience includes a high-thrill speed boat adventure for up to 10 guests departing from the Coronado Ferry Landing to explore San Diego Bay.

*Fuel included
*Life Jackets included for all passengers
*All taxes and fees included
data.cancellation_summary: Cancellations must be made via email 72 hours in advance of reservation to receive a full refund.
data.cancellation_notes:
Your credit card will be charged for the full cost of your rental upon reservation. To make changes or cancellations, you MUST notify us 24 hours in advance of jet ski reservation and 72 hours in advance for boat reservation, otherwise we will not be able to alter your reservation in any way. You will receive a full refund for cancellation due to weather (at discretion of company management).

If booking is made on the same day of reservation, there will be no refund for cancellation.

Rebookings are allowed 24 hours in advance of reservation, however, no refunds will be provided for reservations that have been rebooked.
